added.summary: A timeline's `video` track plays footage on an entity's og.VideoPlayer: `track video "deck" { key 0 { video "clips/kitchen.ogt" from 0 speed 1 } }`. The video's time is `from + (t − key) · speed` at the timeline's time, so seeking a timeline and playing it to the same moment show the same frame, and several segments can share one long file through `from`. Loading the timeline loads its videos; the cook refuses a video it does not have.
